newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian Stocks to Watch Today - Nov 12.

text.p: Some Australian stocks to watch this morning:

Media giant reported a 8.1 percent drop in net profit to A$283 million for the first quarter ending September 30. The company said a stronger Australian dollar and weaker results from US television, Australian newspapers and book publishing offset gains from the movie Independence Day and gains in UK newspapers and book publishing.
Bank reported a 17.7 percent higher full year net profit of A$159.51 million before trading opened.
On Monday, the building materials group CSR Ltd reported a 24 percent lower half year net profit of A$154.7 million and said it saw lower second half earnings as well.
McIntosh Securities shares suspended pending an announcement. Reuters reported from New York on Monday sources saying that Merrill Lynch would launch an takeover for the broker at A$1.40 per share.
